name: Book highlight
oneLiner: a macro shot on a real paper book page curving into its gutter: a highlighter swipes the key sentence on twos, then a real ballpoint writes a note in the margin and draws an arrow up to the line
say: when the speaker quotes a rule or a line worth remembering ('the one line that changed how I work'): the highlighter runs as they read it and the note lands on their comment about it
